scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ui && pnpm run lint:desktop && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.lint:ui-source: node ./node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome lint packages/desktop/src/renderer packages/desktop/scripts packages/ui/src packages/visuals/src
scripts.lint:unused: node ./node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome lint packages/desktop/src packages/desktop/tests packages/desktop/scripts packages/ui/src packages/visuals/src --only=lint/correctness/noUnusedImports --only=lint/correctness/noUnusedVariables
scripts.lint:web: node ./node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome lint packages/workspace/web/src packages/workspace/web/tests packages/visuals/src packages/ui/src
